neighbor_relevance.note: Tautological on synthetic oracle embeddings (constructed from Jurivoc centers)

boilerplate_resistance.note: Now measures actual perturbation sensitivity via TF-IDF text embeddings. TF-IDF baseline shows low resistance (0.14) as expected - boilerplate injection significantly changes embedding. Good legal embeddings should achieve >0.7.

multilingual_invariance.note: Fixed multilingual coverage (was 1 docket, now 50). Synthetic embeddings have independent noise for parallel versions, yielding ~0.4 similarity (above random 0.15 but below strong multilingual model threshold 0.7). Correctly detects lack of cross-language alignment.

corpus_stability.note: Tautological - static pre-computed embeddings never change. Drift ~0 by construction. Test infrastructure works; needs learned embeddings for meaningful measurement.

hierarchy_coherence.note: Meaningful but oracle-dependent: embeddings constructed from Jurivoc centers. Shows clustering method recovers structure when embeddings have legal structure.

required_fixes_addressed: Implemented actual boilerplate perturbation measurement (was hardcoded 0.5 placeholder)
Connected boilerplate injection to text embedding function (TF-IDF)
Fixed multilingual coverage by adding docket_number to ground truth decision_metadata (50 dockets vs 1)
Replaced hand-set baseline constants with documented calibration notes
